scope: Local state/event invariants only. Acoustic performance uses the shared thresholds.json and requires deployment calibration; no acoustic thresholds are weakened here.

transition_verdict_errors.definition: Cases whose accepted/rejected outcome differs from the declared state/event contract.
transition_verdict_errors.artifact_source: cases.jsonl with matching correlation_id; events.jsonl contains content-free observed snapshots.

transition_state_errors.definition: Accepted cases whose resulting floor or candidate return state differs from the declared contract.
transition_state_errors.artifact_source: cases.jsonl with matching correlation_id; events.jsonl contains content-free observed snapshots.

revision_errors.definition: Accepted cases whose revision does not advance exactly once per changed immutable snapshot.
revision_errors.artifact_source: cases.jsonl with matching correlation_id; events.jsonl contains content-free observed snapshots.

rejected_event_mutations.definition: Rejected cases that replace or mutate the previous snapshot.
rejected_event_mutations.artifact_source: cases.jsonl with matching correlation_id; events.jsonl contains content-free observed snapshots.

snapshot_identity_errors.definition: Accepted legal no-ops that replace the immutable snapshot, or changed state that retains the same object.
snapshot_identity_errors.artifact_source: cases.jsonl failure codes from before/after object identity checks.
